## Overview

**Edmund Drake** — a dragonborn artificer who served as captain of the maritime forces of the Tidebound Brotherhood during the era of the First Alliance. He was selected as one of the seven Alliance heroes entrusted with defeating Khar'Zul.

---

## Fate

Edmund Drake died in the first battle against Khar'Zul, alongside Soren Kaien.
